links.outcome: Verifiability of sources cited by general LLMs in evidence-based medicine tasks
links.effect: Limited verifiability of cited sources was reported for the general-purpose LLMs, along with imperfect numerical extraction accuracy. No numeric rates are given in the abstract.
links.quote: However, under current architectures and baseline deployment conditions, several limitations remain, including imperfect accuracy in numerical extraction and processing, limited verifiability of cited sources, inconsistent methodological rigor in synthesis, and weak attribution of clinical responsibility in recommendations.

screen.reason: The study conducts an empirical benchmark evaluation of three baseline general-purpose LLMs across evidence-based medicine tasks to evaluate their capability boundaries, accompanied by philosophical reflection, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
